verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local iOS Unix-like terminal, and a mobile developer tool could plausibly offer cloud agent task management, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no cloud coding agents and no task management or tracking. The relay summary states its only programmatic surfaces are local (Shortcuts and an optional local relay server) and that there is no cloud API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage and track cloud-based coding agent tasks from my phone
